automation_bias.definition: The tendency to trust automated systems more than one's own judgment, especially under pressure or fatigue.

cs_status.definition: The place a person holds in a group: the respect and the authority that other people give them.
cs_status.example: Her status in the room changed the moment she was corrected in front of the client.

information_overload.definition: The state in which incoming information exceeds the capacity to process it, so each new item reduces the value of the ones before it.

lie.definition: Saying something you know is not true, on purpose, to make things easier for yourself.
lie.example: He could have said the wind broke the bowl, but that would be a lie.
